issue_context.title: Xiaomi Miio Air Purifier (FAN)
issue_context.body:
### The problem

There was an update to fun integration that broke Xiaomi Miio. Xiaomi Miio has to be updated to use new fan integration format and etc.

I believe Xiaomi Miio still use deprecated service: fan.set_speed

### What is version of Home Assistant Core has the issue?

core-2021.5.0

### What was the last working version of Home Assistant Core?

core-2021.2.0

### What type of installation are you running?

Home Assistant Container

### Integration causing the issue

Xiaomi Miio

### Link to integration documentation on our website

https://www.home-assistant.io/integrations/xiaomi_miio/

### Example YAML snippet

_No response_

review_comments: Looks otherwise good to me, but should this be a zero for an empty speed list (that are going to be removed soonish)?

I kept it in line with the reset of the code. If speed is not enabled it has no effect. The default is 100.
https://developers.home-assistant.io/docs/core/entity/fan/
Setting it to 0 could make the `speed_step calculation` invalid.
